text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, upon heading over to the training course...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Haa... phew...
How was my time?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The best~! Awesome run!
Trainer, you think so too, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Must be the magic of our hot spring trip, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Actually, the two of us went on one just recently, and...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Phew... that was such a nice bath...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
But why did you suddenly
invite me to the hot springs?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You looked pretty burnt out lately, so
I figured you needed to blow off some steam.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Escaping from ordinary life like this once in a while
feels pretty great, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Palmer... ehehe, thanks!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: By the way, I booked us an aesthetic spa session after this♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
A-A spa...!?
I'm, uh, not really cut out for that kind of stuff...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Come on, come on, don't sweat it!
Let's escape straight into the extraordinary!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Focusing hard is fine and all,
but knowing when to run away matters too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... The spa was a shock at first, but
my muscles have an amazing glow now thanks to it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, that manga you were reading the other day
had an elopement to a hot spring in it, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! It was so heart-throbbing...!
That scene where they walked hand-in-hand on the mountain path...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, how do you know
what manga I've been reading!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I love that manga too♪
A love escape... Running away for love is so nice, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
R-R-Running away for love...!?
Hold on, Palmer, what are you even saying...!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: No, no, this is serious talk, hear me out!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The characters in the manga fulfilled their feelings
precisely because they escaped into an extraordinary world.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: In short: Love and Escaping save the world!
choice_data_list: It's true that extraordinary experiences help you grow

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: In short: Love and Escaping save the world!
choice_data_list: It's true that extraordinary experiences help you grow

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You escaped the daily grind to the hot springs
and showed some proper care to your muscles, right, Ryan?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Didn't that let you express your heartfelt love
to the muscles that always work so hard for you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You're so right...! Lately I hadn't been
giving my muscles enough love and care!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I was so impatient to build them up that I pushed them too far...
I completely ignored how my muscles felt.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Palmer, thank you so much
for making me realize something so important!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep! Glad I could help out, Ryan.
Keep enjoying your love-escape with your muscles, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Totally! Whenever folks go training in seclusion,
they always escape from the worldly noise first.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I get it! The hot springs and spa were
a form of ascetic mental discipline for me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Palmer! I'll treat a cold shower like waterfall training
and go ice my muscles right away!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, typical muscle fanatic Ryan.
Escaping to a waterfall is pretty novel♪
